archetypes.name: dyn-bg-wait
archetypes.rationale: Shared marker and Step 3 arming need lifecycle scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the extracted implement bg-wait marker helper and its callers. Verify marker field order, CLONE_PATH propagation, sentinel cleanup, and Step 3-only arming in the Python run-step-checks path. Check that non-Step 3 paths stay unmarked. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
